notes:
Office Copilot 0.2.5 (beta)

- fix: show the chat pane in 32-bit Office (SetWindowLongPtr is not in 32-bit user32)
- test: show the real pane in 32-bit and 64-bit processes before a release

Package: OneNote / Word / Excel / PowerPoint desktop add-ins for 64-bit or 32-bit Office on 64-bit Windows 10/11 (x64 / ARM64 with x64 Office); the setup registers for the Office bitness it finds. Run OfficeCopilot-Setup-0.2.5.exe (administrator rights are required: the COM classes are registered machine-wide; the wizard asks whether the add-ins are turned on for this user only or for every user of the PC), then restart the Office apps and open the "Copilot" tab.

Includes the read-only OneNote MCP server (C:\Program Files\OfficeCopilot\mcp\OfficeExport.exe, started as "OfficeExport.exe mcp"; built from onenote-export ae49d6c) for VS Code, the Copilot CLI and the Word / Excel / PowerPoint chat (mcpServers in settings.json). Register it as a stdio MCP server: command = that path, args = ["mcp"].

The Copilot runtime is not bundled. Install the GitHub Copilot CLI (npm install -g @github/copilot, or winget install GitHub.Copilot) and sign in; the setup and the chat pane show these instructions when no CLI is found. Each chat turn uses GitHub Copilot premium requests. Excel / PowerPoint writes cannot be undone with Office's Undo (the pane has its own "undo last insert"). 32-bit Windows and automatic updates are not supported.

Beta validation: automated Core unit tests; installer install / load / uninstall in both scopes checked on Windows 11 ARM64 with x64 Microsoft 365. Registration for 32-bit Office was checked only without 32-bit Office (32-bit registry view, add-in classes created from a 32-bit process); please report problems with 32-bit Office. The setup is not code-signed (SmartScreen may warn).
